Card Q&A.a: No, the cards weren't being flipped over by a security check, so their [Security] effects don't activate.
Card Q&A.q: Do cards trashed from my opponent’s security stack by this card's [When Attacking] effect activate their [Security] effects?

My opponent has 1 or more cards in their security stack. I attack my opponent with this Digimon and its [When Attacking] effect trashes their last security cards, leaving them with zero cards in their security stack. If the attack isn't blocked and my attack is successful when they have zero cards in their security stack, do I win the game?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP.[When Attacking] Trash the top card of your opponent's security stack. Add 1 to the number of cards trashed by this effect for every 10 cards in your opponent's trash.
